# N6 BIRR: complete geometry and exact cap tables

These fixed tables are part of [N6_BIRR.md](N6_BIRR.md). All
determinants refer to the ten actual points and the closed box in
[N6_BIRR_SETUP.md](N6_BIRR_SETUP.md). Every finite branch is printed.
The separate [area chains](N6_BIRR_AREA_CHAINS.md) print every scalar
leaf. No discovery file or optimization is a premise.

## Nonnegative box-corner differences

For sorted indices i0,...,ik, corner m uses the upper endpoint at ij
exactly when bit j is one. Every entry is cap minus signed determinant
at that corner. All differences are nonnegative; multiaffinity proves
the stated bound throughout the whole closed box.
